tracks.title: Marbert Rocel - Hush Now

tracks.title: Fischerspooner - Emerge

tracks.title: Felix Da Housecat - Madame Hollywood (feat. Miss Kittin)

tracks.title: ACRAZE - Do It To It (feat. Cherish)

tracks.title: Tinush - Sandburg
tracks.description: 'Sandburg' by Tinush is a deep and soulful house track that captivates with its smooth melodies, textured soundscapes, and hypnotic rhythms. Its intricate production and emotional depth create a mesmerizing atmosphere that invites listeners into a reflective sonic journey.

tracks.title: The xx - Crystalised
tracks.description: 'Crystalised' by The xx is an evocative indie pop track blending minimalistic production with haunting vocals. Its delicate balance of intimacy and tension makes it a standout, capturing themes of vulnerability and complex relationships.

tracks.title: The Police - Roxanne
tracks.description: 'Roxanne' by The Police is a timeless blend of rock and reggae, telling the story of unrequited love and infatuation with a woman living a dangerous lifestyle. With Sting’s iconic voice and the band’s unique sound, 'Roxanne' became one of the defining tracks of the late 70s.

tracks.title: Lucky Luke - Cooler Than Me
tracks.description: 'Cooler Than Me' by Lucky Luke is a fresh take on Mike Posner's original hit, blending deep house and electronic elements to create a laid-back, catchy anthem. The track brings a modern, chill vibe while retaining the edgy attitude of the original lyrics.

tracks.title: Klangkarussell - We Want Your Soul
tracks.description: 'We Want Your Soul' by Klangkarussell is a high-energy electronic track that critiques modern consumerism. With its hypnotic beats and provocative sampled lyrics, the song delivers a bold message while maintaining an infectious groove.

tracks.title: Groove Armada - Superstylin'
tracks.description: 'Superstylin'' by Groove Armada is a high-energy fusion of house, dub, and breakbeat, featuring bold brass, reggae vocals, and infectious grooves. The track delivers an exhilarating dancefloor experience while embodying a free-spirited, celebratory vibe.

tracks.title: Gorgon City - Hard On Me
tracks.description: 'Hard On Me' by Gorgon City is a sleek, deep house track that combines pulsating rhythms with heartfelt vocals. The track encapsulates the emotional push and pull of relationships, blending smooth production with an infectious groove that resonates on both the dance floor and in personal reflection.

tracks.title: Gabriella Cilmi - Cry Me a River (Cover)

tracks.title: Freeland - Under Control

tracks.title: Fort Minor - Remember The Name
tracks.description: 'Remember The Name' by Fort Minor is an anthem of perseverance and determination, emphasizing the hard work and dedication it takes to achieve greatness. With its iconic chorus and powerful lyrics, the track motivates listeners to stay focused and push through obstacles.

tracks.title: Eurythmics - Sweet Dreams (Ibiza Deep Summer Remix 2015)

The remix blends the track's dark, hypnotic melodies with breezy, uplifting beats, giving it a fresh yet nostalgic vibe.
